results.title: Customer Acquisition Cost Benchmarks 2026: By Industry
results.snippet: The cycle-length increase translates almost directly into CAC inflation because sales labor accrues per day in pipeline. Reducing sales cycle length by 10% is mathematically equivalent to reducing CAC by approximately 7-9% in sales-led motions, which is why pipeline velocity has overtaken win rate as the metric most correlated with CAC efficiency in the OpenView benchmarks.
